package main
import (
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "strings"
 "path"
 "github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/ast"
 "github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/core"
 "github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/parser"
 "github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/tspath"
 cfg "github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/ecmascript/control_flow_graph"
)
func main() {
 data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[2]); if err != nil { panic(err) }
 var inputs []struct{ File, Source, Rule string }
 if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &inputs); err != nil { panic(err) }
 facts := [][]int{}
 coverage := map[string][]int{}
 for _, row := range inputs {
  kind := core.ScriptKindTS
  if strings.HasSuffix(row.File,".tsx") { kind = core.ScriptKindTSX } else if strings.HasSuffix(row.File,".jsx") { kind = core.ScriptKindJSX } else if strings.HasSuffix(row.File,".js") { kind = core.ScriptKindJS }
  name := path.Clean("/corpus/"+row.File)
  source := parser.ParseSourceFile(ast.SourceFileParseOptions{FileName:name,Path:tspath.Path(name)}, row.Source,kind)
  nodes := []*ast.Node{}
  ids := map[*ast.Node]int{nil:0}
  var visit func(*ast.Node)
  visit = func(node *ast.Node) { nodes=append(nodes,node); ids[node]=len(nodes); node.ForEachChild(func(child *ast.Node) bool {visit(child); return false}) }
  visit(source.AsNode())
  for _, node := range nodes {
   if os.Args[1] == "--coverage" { counts := coverage[row.Rule]; if len(counts)==0 { counts=[]int{0,0} }; counts[0]++; counts[1]+=len(cfg.AdamicDecoratorCalls(node));coverage[row.Rule]=counts;continue }
   if os.Args[1] == "--want" {
    calls:=cfg.AdamicDecoratorCalls(node)
    fmt.Print(len(calls)); for _, call := range calls {fmt.Printf("|%d",ids[call])};fmt.Println()
   } else {
    expressions:=[]int{}
    for _, decorator:=range node.Decorators() { expressions=append(expressions,ids[decorator.AsDecorator().Expression]) }
    facts=append(facts,expressions)
   }
  }
 }
 if os.Args[1] == "--coverage" { if err:=json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(coverage);err!=nil {panic(err)};return }
 if os.Args[1] != "--want" { if err:=json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(facts);err!=nil {panic(err)} }
}
